strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Enemy enters the laboratory
1. All allies destroyed
Wahahahaha!
So this is all a lab without Great Mazinger amounts to!
Did we make it in time!?
You're late, Gandor unit!
I'd love to take you on, but I already have what I came for!
No way! Great Mazinger!?
Isn't Great Mazinger in the robot museum in Tokyo?
Yeah, Great Mazinger was definitely there.
Then what on earth did they...!
Fuhahahaha, you'll find out soon enough! Soon enough! Hahahahaha!
What!? He ran off!
But it looked like he got what he came for.
What the heck is going on!
Looks like we can't go after him.
...For now, wiping out the enemies left here comes first.
Mechanical Beasts!? Hm, looks like that one's the leader.
Nngh, they moved faster than expected.
Gandor unit, was it? You have my praise!
Tch! Praise from an all-show, no-go chump like you
doesn't make me happy one bit!
All talk, aren't you?
Very well, I shall take my leave for today.
Whoa, retreating already? No excuses for that one, old man.
Unlike you lot, I'm a busy man.
Mechanical Beasts, huh... Anyway, we can't let them into the lab...
Queen Star, in!
Venus A, go!
Fire On!!
Scrambler Daaash!!
Queen Star, in!
Venus A, go!
Fire On!!
Scrambler Daaash!!
Tetsuya!?
So Great Mazinger was pulled out of the robot museum too!
The adjustments took a while. I'll make up for it now.
You made it in time, so no worries! Now, let's go!
Commander Hazuki, Dr. Kabuto told us the situation.
Great Mazinger and Venus A are joining the Gandor unit!
You won't say no, will you, Commander!
No, I should be the one asking.
Tsurugi, Honoo, you'll both be under my command... Is that all right?
Dr. Kabuto and Prof. Yumi both think highly of you.
I'll trust you, Commander.
Enemy reinforcements!? No, this reading is... mobile suits!
Is that... a Gogg?
Showing up at a time like this...!
Looks like the intel on the Federation retrieving a new weapon was true.
But they're already in combat, you know?
Who cares? We just rain missiles on 'em from here.
Tch, so being right on the sea backfired...!
Looks like it's Getter-3's turn to shine!
I see, the Getter Robo...
A super robot that can handle land, sea, and air.
This situation's made to order.
It's all yours, Benkei!
Damn! The enemy's in the lab...
...The Great General of Darkness... what's his goal?
He was commanding the Mechanical Beast army...
Baron Ashura and Dr. Hell...
No, he was calling himself by some fancy name, Marshal of Hell.
Is that guy the one backing them...?
Who cares, I tell ya. It's just gettin' to be a real hassle.
Oh, Boss, honestly.
It's not like before, where we just had to beat the enemy.
Right. Honestly, it doesn't look like it'll be that simple.
If only we knew more clearly who the enemy is...
For now, we have no choice but to build up our forces and press on.
We still have no word from Jaburo either.
Who they are? Isn't it just leftover Mechanical Beasts and the Gaizok?
If it were that clear-cut, we could plan our strategy...
Geez, grown-ups worry way too much about everything.
...Not thinking enough is a problem too.
Commander, let's just get moving.
Right... All units, return to the ship. Keep up repairs and upkeep.
(...The Great General of Darkness. Just what did he get his hands on?)
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
